verdict: THE CLOSED-LIST ARM IS THE STUDY'S SLURP DIRECT BASELINE. Intent (scen_act) 71.40 against the sealed M0 comparator's 53.60, +17.80 pp paired, and SLU-F1 35.80 against 36.90, -1.10. The intent gain is the He and Garner asymmetry reproduced on audio input; the slot layer does not move. Four fifths of the locked BLEND cell's SLURP intent margin over M0 is reproduced by a prompt-side label inventory with zero retrieval and zero extra contacts.
